paris-rambouillet-chevreuse-forest-doubl.slogan: A 192 km loop out of Paris south-west exit
paris-rambouillet-chevreuse-forest-doubl.story: Two forests, village bends and a proper escape without wasting the morning. A 192 km loop that starts and ends near Vélizy-Villacoublay, about 3 h 52 of riding. On the way it passes Chevreuse valley road, Rambouillet forest stop, Dampierre castle sight and Saint-Rémy.
